description.value:
When you or a creature within 5 feet of you that you can see is about to take damage from an attack, you may react — provided you wield a melee weapon or a shield — by rolling 1d8 and adding it to that target's AC against the triggering attack. If the attack still connects, the target gains resistance to its damage.

You have three uses of this feature, gaining one more at 9th, 13th, and 17th level; a long rest restores all spent uses.
